title: fix(mocker): restrict redirect mocks to the fs allowlist

target.summary: Redirect mock paths are resolved by joining server.config.root with redirectUrl.pathname using POSIX join without normalizing Windows path separators. On Windows, backslash directory traversal sequences are not resolved by POSIX join, allowing redirect mocks to bypass isFileLoadingAllowed and access files outside the allowed roots.
